strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
It's them...!
The Einst...!
An energy reading... and it's the mystery enemy?!
Heh, isn't this who Kyosuke's crew wants to see most right now?
What do you mean?
If that enemy shows up now that Excellen's back...
...it means they're planning their next move.
Exactly.
They might still be thinking of doing something to us.
Not that I should be glad to run into the enemy... Moving out...!
We're heading out too, is that okay?!
Yes, please sortie.
...I don't get it.
Huh?
That mystery enemy has never shown up on radar, heat sensors...
...or any kind of search until now.
Is that so?
It always felt like they were outsmarting us.
...That's right. We've run into them many times...
...but we've never detected them ahead of time.
I see. So why did they suddenly show up on our sensors now...?
In other words... Amuro, you don't mean...
It's a lure. To draw us here.
A lure?
These guys are so vague. What are they even after?
(Something's... still behind them...? It feels like someone's watching...)
Kyosuke.
I know. ...It's here.
If they block our path, we defeat them...! No holding back.
Annoying bunch. If you're coming, come all at once...!
I don't know... I've got a really bad feeling about this...
Whatever the case, we must shake off the sparks that fall on us.
If we could just beat 'em till they talked, it'd be easy!
...That's not the kind of thing a kid should say.
Kyosuke, Excellen... Can you hear the enemy's voices?
No, not right now...
Seems they're the quiet type this time...
We can't run. All units, attack!
It's over!
You can't escape! Sorry, little girl...
That red robot is...!
Alchemie...!
There you are, little girl.
Tch, here comes a real pain...!
...It's been a while... both of you...
Oh? Seems you're speaking so we can hear you too this time.
Yes... I've become... quite stable now.
What do you mean?
I can't... become you yet, though.
What...?
(The Einst series. Not like the aliens... either... What are they?)
Quit talking nonsense!
Yeah, explain it so we can understand!
...You wouldn't be able to understand... I think.
Ugh, how rude!
I've no interest in hearing your nonsense from the start!
...But answer me this! ...Why did you target the Devil Gundam?!
Domon...
...Self-evolution, self-multiplication, self-regeneration...
I wondered if humans could become something other than human...
That makes no sense. Get to the point.
......But that Gundam was incomplete.
It's not usable yet... And my body, too...
Th-That's pretty complicated... Ruri, do you get it?
I fed Omoikane various keywords to guess... It makes no sense.
(...I can't remember... but... I feel like there's something in her body...)
Not usable? Of course not!
That's not the Ultimate Gundam my father wanted!
Yes... A complete one, perhaps. But it's already time.
For me, and for those of the land of beginnings...
I see, so that's why you didn't appear at the colony
the Devil Gundam took over...!
What's this "land of beginnings"?!
Yeah, we keep hearing it... Does it really mean Earth?!
...There's no need... to answer.
It's a story that will soon have nothing to do with you...
This is pointless. ...Why not speak in your own words?
Kyosuke... I am... me.
...No, it doesn't sound like it.
What... are you to me...? What do you want?
...Excellen... You are... my...
We did it...!
All right, blown to pieces!
Yeah! That's the end of that!
Maybe that was a little sad... Not that I'd grown attached.
...I wonder.
Is something wrong?
She seemed to be the only Einst that could speak.
Now we can't get anything out of her.
That's not it... Is that really the end? Excellen, what do you think?
...Yeah, she's "watching."
Hey, hey, then that means...
We can't let our guard down... is that it?
Ruri.
Continuing to monitor. Omoikane, if you would.
(...I doubt it's just needless worry.)
It can't be...!
I knew it.
...It won't be... that easy.
It was definitely destroyed... Even if the machine can be mass-produced...
The pilot too?! ...Twins or something?
...Probably... the same person.
You can tell, Mia?!
...That strange aura... It's the same.
Aura Power differs from person to person... If it's the same...
No need to wonder... It's definitely Alchemie... same as before.
...This Person-Lichkeit... protects me... As many times... as it takes...
Person-Lichkeit...?! Is that the robot's name?
...Being here, I can feel you, Kyosuke... That is because Excellen...
(...It can't be...)
What are you trying to say?!
What're you all yakking about?!
Them showing up again ain't anything new!
That's convincing.
Once in a while, sure. ...Come on, you two! No time to space out!
...Roger.
Now, now, getting so angry will give you more wrinkles, you know?
What did you say?!
(Whew... But I'm starting to see it... how she and I are linked...)
As I thought... it was too soon... And besides...
What...? Its power suddenly... weakened...?!
There's... no time left...
Hey!
...There's no time, Kyosuke... For you all... or for me...
...Kyosuke.
Yeah, I'm starting to get the picture.
But what they're after... whoever's behind that girl... I still don't know...
What is she...? That girl...
She flew off at an incredible speed...
What the heck? What's going on?!
Just when she came back to life... she goes down awful easy.
I doubt they just let us off... Watch out for the remaining enemies!
And that red machine... might come back!
Alchemie...
No time... What does she mean...?
...No enemy signals?!
So it seems.
...But the Einst normally don't show up on our sensors anyway...
So they might be hiding, then?
Provided they aren't hiding, there's no one around.
Huh, we've met her lots of times, but... what is she, anyway? That girl...
...The Einst's combat leader, more or less.
Is that really all?
Oh my, Kyosuke, they're suspecting you?
You as well, as a set.
Wow, figured as much?
Hey, are you two friends of the Einst?
What the heck? Are you guys calling them here?
Maybe you give off some sound wave people can't normally hear.
Hey now, I'm not a dog whistle.
Hmph, and a rabid dog at that.
I'm not sure... but at the very least, they'll keep coming after us.
I don't think you're hiding the truth. But... you really don't know anything?
...I have plenty of theories. But the truth... I have no idea...
